answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 2128 Country: United States of America Title: I had a question regarding taraweeh prayers. What are the requirements for someone to lead taraweeh? Is beard one of them. And if it is does it have to be handful. Question: Asslam Wa Alaikum. I had a question regarding taraweeh prayers. What are the requirements for someone to lead taraweeh? Is beard one of them. And if it is does it have to be handful. Jazakallah Answer ID: 2128 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 999/999=J) The one who leads taraweeh must be having a fistful beard. It has been clearly mentioned by the scholars of Fiqh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
